# Mobile App Privacy Policy

**Effective date:** May 13, 2026  
**Applies to:** OralEye Mobile App (Android)

This Privacy Policy describes how OralEye collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use the OralEye mobile application.

## Who We Are

**Image Data Management, Inc.** ("OralEye", "we", "our", "us") operates the OralEye mobile app for dental imaging workflows.

## Information We Collect

We may collect the following categories of information:

- **Account and authentication data**: Sign-in identifiers and authentication tokens (for example, via Firebase Authentication).
- **Clinical image data**: Images captured using your device camera while using the app.
- **App usage and diagnostics**: Technical information needed to operate, secure, and troubleshoot the service.
- **Device and network metadata**: Basic device/app version data and network request metadata used for reliability and security.

## Permissions We Request

The app requests the following Android permissions:

- **Camera (`android.permission.CAMERA`)**: Used to capture intraoral images as part of app functionality.
- **Internet (`android.permission.INTERNET`)**: Used to communicate with OralEye backend services.
- **Storage-related permissions** (if present on specific Android versions): Used to save or access images needed for workflow.

We do not use camera access for background surveillance or unrelated purposes.

## How We Use Information

We use collected information to:

- Provide core app functionality (image capture, processing, and retrieval).
- Authenticate users and secure access to data.
- Maintain, monitor, and improve reliability and performance.
- Comply with legal, regulatory, and safety obligations.

## Legal Basis and Purpose Limitation

We process information only for legitimate operational and clinical workflow purposes, and only to the extent necessary for those purposes.

## Data Sharing

We do not sell personal information.

We may share information only with:

- **Service providers** that help operate the app (for example, cloud hosting and authentication providers such as Google Firebase).
- **Authorized users and organizations** associated with your clinical workflow.
- **Regulatory or legal authorities** when required by law.

## Data Storage and Security

We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

No system is 100% secure, but we apply security best practices and access controls appropriate to the service.

## Data Retention

We retain information only as long as needed for operational, clinical, legal, and compliance purposes, then securely delete or de-identify it where appropriate.

## Children

The app is intended for professional/clinical use and is not directed to children.

## International Transfers

Your information may be processed in regions where our infrastructure or service providers operate, subject to applicable safeguards.

## Your Choices and Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to:

- Request access to your personal information.
- Request correction or deletion.
- Object to or restrict certain processing.
- Withdraw consent where consent is the legal basis.

To submit a request, contact us using the details below.

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the effective date and, where appropriate, additional notice.

## Contact Us

For privacy questions or requests:

- **Email:** privacy@oraleye.ai
- **Support:** support@oraleye.ai
- **Website:** https://oraleye.ai
